scope: Single-sample targeted SNVs and small indels with nonoverlapping BED4; upstream experimental Java Fisher mode and unchanged official Perl converter. Not somatic-status, arbitrary-ploidy or clinical validation.

validation.fisherAgreement: All p-values and finite conditional odds ratios exactly agree at the official upstream five-decimal rounding; not a proof for all inputs.
validation.pathEvidence: Actual Linux argv and run folders with spaces pass; semicolon, pipe and non-ASCII paths rejected. Windows long-path and space-path runtime execution remains untested.

privateRuntime.java: Complete unmodified official Temurin8u504-b01 Windows x64 JRE
privateRuntime.perl: Unmodified StrawberryPerl5.42.3.1 interpreter, five PE files and seven core modules; fixed private-module converter adapter

independentStaticWindowsAudit.limitation: PE dependency and byte comparisons establish packaging evidence, not native Windows execution.

notices: Original runtime notices, source archives, JRegex/HTSJDK source notices and original Microsoft runtime license retained. Microsoft runtime DLLs explicitly identified as separate proprietary components; no GPL attribution or legal redistribution guarantee is asserted.
reproduction: scripts/fetch_vardict_vendor.py verifies 14 pinned build assets; validation/vardict-0.5.3-reproduction.md describes assembly and Linux reference tests.
